verses.text: <ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡe</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>竟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>敢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>嘴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>窑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yáo</rt></ruby><ruby>匠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>团<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuán</rt></ruby><ruby>泥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ní</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>块<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby>做<ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>贵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>皿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>块<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby>做<ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>卑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>贱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>皿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>倘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>忿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèn</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>彰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>忍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rěn</rt></ruby><ruby>耐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nài</rt></ruby><ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby>、<ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>遭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāo</rt></ruby><ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>皿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>丰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>彰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>悯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>皿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>皿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>召<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hé</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>阿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>书<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby>“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby>”；<ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby>“<ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>”。

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>”。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>喊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>虽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suī</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>剩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>余<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>速<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby><ruby>速<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>完<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wán</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>军<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>余<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>蛾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">É</rt></ruby><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mó</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>追<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuī</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>反<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 以色列人和福音

verses.text: <ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>追<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuī</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>反<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>缘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>绊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>锡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>块<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>绊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>磐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pán</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>；<ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>愧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuì</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>证<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>热<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rè</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>真<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēn</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>总<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>写<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiě</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby>。”
verses.heading: 求告主名的必要得救

verses.text: <ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>升<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？（<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>；）

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby>，“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>饿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>渴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>炭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>堆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duī</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>；<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>总<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>宁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>绊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>确<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>深<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>独<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>忧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yōu</rt></ruby><ruby>愁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>替<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>败<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby><ruby>坏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huài</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>谤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bànɡ</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>乎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hu</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby>，<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>乎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hu</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>、<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>几<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>侍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>悦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>务<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>追<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuī</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>睦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>建<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>德<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>坏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huài</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>工<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>程<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>固<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wú</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>概<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡài</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby>做<ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby>。<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>责<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zé</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>疑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>坚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>固<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>该<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāi</rt></ruby><ruby>担<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dān</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>坚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>固<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>软<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>弱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>悦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 不求自己的喜悦，要叫邻舍喜悦

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>务<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>邻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>舍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>悦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>益<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>建<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>德<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>悦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rú</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>辱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>骂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mà</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>辱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>骂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mà</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>写<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiě</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>写<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiě</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>忍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rěn</rt></ruby><ruby>耐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nài</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>慰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby><ruby>盼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>忍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rěn</rt></ruby><ruby>耐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nài</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>慰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>效<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiào</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>、<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>纳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>纳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 神的福音一视同仁

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>真<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēn</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>割<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>礼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>执<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>证<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>祖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>悯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>。<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rú</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>兴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>仰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>盼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>诸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhū</rt></ruby><ruby>般<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby>、<ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>充<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>藉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>盼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby>！
